extra.message: The administrator password-reset branch replaces the password but does not revoke existing AuthSession records. extra.message: A successful password reset removes only the submitted token from _reset_tokens. Other tokens previously issued for the same user remain valid until their individual expiry; change_password() also leaves them intact. Someone holding an older unused token can reset the password again after the legitimate user completes recovery or changes their password.

extra.message: Password-reset tokens are appended in plaintext alongside account emails to password_reset_mailbox.log without a debug-only guard or restrictive file mode. cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: Every unauthenticated password-reset request for an enabled account adds a new entry to the process-global dictionary.
